prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 中文 · 课程表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 7 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "节次" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 2: header "时间" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 92px
  col 3: header "周一" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 92px
  col 4: header "周二" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "周三" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 6: header "周四" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 7: header "周五" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 169px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示一周各节课的时间和课程，方便查看每日安排及比较同一时段的课程。","reading":"读者可以沿行查看某一节课在各工作日的安排，也可以沿列查看某一天的课程；节次和时间共同定位每一行。","groups":["节次、时间：共同标识课程所在的时段。","周一至周五：承担相同的课程安排功能，应便于横向比较；周一和周五有较长课程名称。"],"keep_intact":["节次数字","时间中的单个时刻，如08:00和08:45","课程名称应保持字序完整，不截断"],"may_wrap":["较长的课程名称可按中文阅读习惯换行","时间范围可在连接符附近换行；同一行较长课程名称产生的行高可容纳时间换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [38, 71, 52, 45, 45, 38, 70] · table 360×428px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 106, 60, 83] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [38, 71, 52, 52, 52, 38, 56] · table 360×474px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 153, 60, 83] · column headers wrapped 2/7 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [38, 71, 52, 52, 38, 52, 56] · table 360×474px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 153, 60, 83] · column headers wrapped 2/7 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"周一和周五获得较多空间，长课程名称分别排成三行和四行；时间中的单个时刻保持完整。相比另外两案，第三节的行高较低，整表节奏更紧凑。","problems":"节次及周二至周四的表头竖排，三个工作日的大多数双字课程也被拆成两行，横向比较时需要反复转换阅读方向。","cause":"节次和周四各38px，周二、周三各45px，扣除21px的内边距和边框后都不足以容纳两个汉字。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"周一至周三的表头和双字课程保持横排，工作日之间的扫描较顺畅；时间范围分两行且时刻完整。","problems":"周四表头和课程竖排，节次表头也竖排。周五的长课程被切成六行，第三节因此过高，其他列留下大片空白，削弱了这一行的整体感。","cause":"节次和周四各38px，只能容纳一个汉字；周五56px仅能容纳两个汉字，长课程名称因而逐行堆叠。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"周一、周二和周四的表头及双字课程保持横排；时间中的单个时刻完整。","problems":"周三表头和课程竖排，节次表头也竖排。周五长课程造成六行高的第三节，大片空白使同一时段的课程比较不够紧凑。","cause":"周三和节次各38px，只能容纳一个汉字；周五56px只能容纳两个汉字，导致长课程过度换行。"},{"design":"r2D","good":"保留r2A对周一和周五长课程的照顾，同时让周二的表头和双字课程横排。","problems":"节次、周三和周四仍会竖排；周五长课程仍需多行。","cause":"将周二加至52px，所需宽度由周三缩至38px提供；周五保持70px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r3A","widths":[38,71,52,52,38,38,70],"change":"将r2A的周二加宽到52px，让其表头和双字课程横排；周三缩至38px，保留周一及周五的长课程宽度。"},{"name":"r3B","widths":[38,71,38,38,38,52,84],"change":"把更多空间给周五，使最长课程有望按每行四个汉字排版；周四保持双字横排，代价是周一长课程及另外两个工作日更加狭窄。"},{"name":"r3C","widths":[52,71,38,38,38,52,70],"change":"加宽节次以保持表头横排，并让周四的常见双字课程横排；周一至周三收窄，检验清晰的时段标识能否补偿课程列的更多换行。"}]}
